capabilities: Generate a Weekly Review note linking all files created in the last week
Run the review from the "Start Review" command in the command palette
disambiguation: It does not open the notes for review; it generates a new note containing links to them.
extras: The README credits the original plugin's author and states the rest of the code is unchanged; a video walkthrough covers installation and usage.
intentEvidence: Weekly review linker is a fork of the weekly review plugin.
motivation: The author forked the original weekly review plugin because opening each note was less useful than having one file that links them, which keeps weekly notes connected in the graph.
problem: With periodic notes, the notes created during a week are not connected to the weekly note, so a week's output is invisible in the graph.

relations.evidence: Weekly review linker is a fork of the weekly review plugin.
This helps a lot for using periodic notes

summary: Fork of the weekly review plugin that creates a note linking all files created in the past week, instead of opening them one by one.
